transform_litellm_data_to_cbf: transform a polars DataFrame of LiteLLM usage data into CloudZero CBF format
create_cbf_record_from_row: create a single CBF record from a LiteLLM daily spend row dictionary
parse_date_string: parse a date string from daily spend tables into a UTC datetime object
